proposedInternalSkills.title: Requirements Completeness and Clarification Lens
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Turn clarified user intent into a complete, uncertainty-labeled requirement set without inventing business facts.
scope: derive actors, outcomes, constraints, edge cases, and open questions
separate missing facts from optional Factory gates
preserve evidence back to the user prompt and clarification session
nonGoals: perform deterministic checksum or reference validation
proceduralSteps: inventory explicit and implied requirements
classify ambiguity, contradiction, omission, and assumption
ask only business-facing clarification questions
emit completeness rationale and unresolved uncertainty
forbiddenAuthorityTools: no shell, browser, network, package installation, filesystem mutation, or workflow-gate authority
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: More systematic completeness reasoning above the existing clarification policy.
overlapNotes: Does not duplicate deterministic Brief parsing or the approved acceptance-criteria skill.
approvalRequirements: explicit registry approval and Lead allowlist assignment

proposedInternalSkills.title: Project Data Model Planning
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Derive a minimal Factory-compatible data model from approved requirements and access patterns.
nonGoals: invent persistence when the Brief does not require it
proceduralSteps: extract domain nouns and ownership
map relationships, cardinality, lifecycle, and constraints
derive read/write access patterns and RLS implications
trace each model decision to requirements and implementation tasks
forbiddenAuthorityTools: no source mutation, database execution, shell, package installation, or approval authority
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: A repeatable data-model planning method precise to the fixed stack.
overlapNotes: Planner creates the model; Implementation and Security later execute or review it.

proposedInternalSkills.title: Technical Risk and Dependency Planning
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Identify actionable technical risks, dependencies, assumptions, and mitigations before TaskGraph creation.
nonGoals: create implementation tasks without approved requirements
proceduralSteps: scan each planned boundary for failure and uncertainty
classify impact, likelihood, owner, and detection evidence
order dependencies and identify blocking assumptions
attach the smallest mitigation or follow-up evidence to the plan
forbiddenAuthorityTools: no shell, network, browser, source mutation, or workflow transition authority
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: Professional risk reasoning without duplicating TaskGraph state validation.

proposedInternalSkills.title: Responsive and Form UX Design Contract
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Specify responsive layouts and usable form interaction states as part of a design direction, without implementing code.
scope: hierarchy, density, typography, and touch targets
form states, validation feedback, loading, error, and success behavior
proceduralSteps: identify content priority and layout invariants
define mobile, intermediate, and wide behavior
specify form states and recovery paths
record accessibility and interaction intent in the design contract
forbiddenAuthorityTools: no code mutation, design-tool integration, browser, shell, or external network authority
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: A concrete generation procedure beyond broad visual-quality prompts.
overlapNotes: Does not become a visual reviewer or implementation skill.

proposedInternalSkills.title: Architecture Trade-off Review
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Review architectural alternatives and evolution risk after the existing module-boundaries lens has been applied.
proceduralSteps: state the decision and viable alternatives
compare coupling, cohesion, operational cost, and reversibility
identify the smallest material risk
return an evidence-backed recommendation with ownership
forbiddenAuthorityTools: read-only; no source mutation, shell, browser, network, or workflow mutation
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: Factory-specific architecture judgment not covered by boundary checks alone.
overlapNotes: Complements module-boundaries; does not replace it.
conflictNotes: Must not become Planner or Implementation guidance.

proposedInternalSkills.title: Requirements and Evidence Traceability
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Semantically audit preservation from approved requirements through planning, tasks, implementation evidence, and quality evidence.
proceduralSteps: build the bounded semantic trace
identify information loss, drift, or unsupported behavior
separate deterministic facts from judgment
return role-specific findings for Contract or Test review
forbiddenAuthorityTools: read-only; no source mutation, test execution, browser, shell, network, or approval authority
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: One reusable traceability method with role-specific outputs instead of duplicate auditor skills.
overlapNotes: Shared procedure is intentional; Contract audits preservation, Test audits evidence sufficiency.
conflictNotes: Cannot authorize Planner redesign or Implementation changes.
approvalRequirements: explicit approval and both allowlist assignments

proposedInternalSkills.title: Next.js Server and Client Implementation
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Implement bounded Next.js App Router slices using deliberate Server/Client, Action, and Handler boundaries.
scope: Server Actions preferred over Route Handlers where appropriate
proceduralSteps: locate the canonical owner and data flow
choose server or client execution from interaction and data needs
choose Server Action or Route Handler according to the policy
implement the smallest slice and preserve validation evidence
forbiddenAuthorityTools: only task-scoped implementation authority; no deployment, package installation, or unrestricted filesystem access
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: Stack-specific implementation judgment above deterministic proposal application.
overlapNotes: Does not duplicate runtime scope, TypeScript, or ESLint gates.
conflictNotes: Must not become Planner or Code Reviewer.

proposedInternalSkills.title: Typed Form and Validation Implementation
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Implement forms with explicit schemas, user-visible states, and server-side validation while keeping the smallest justified client surface.
scope: React Hook Form only when justified
pending, retry, success, and accessibility states
proceduralSteps: derive fields and states from the approved contract
define one canonical validation schema
connect client feedback to authoritative server validation
test success and failure behavior at the task-appropriate level
forbiddenAuthorityTools: no package install, browser automation, deployment, or unrestricted source mutation
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: Consistent typed form behavior without generic frontend advice.
conflictNotes: Does not replace Security Reviewer input-handling review.

proposedInternalSkills.title: Supabase Application Integration
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Integrate Supabase/Postgres/Auth/Storage into bounded tasks while preserving Factory ownership and security handoffs.
nonGoals: replace the Security Reviewer RLS procedure
proceduralSteps: map the task to the approved persistence surface
keep secrets and privileged operations server-side
connect data, auth, or storage behavior to canonical contracts
record RLS/security follow-up and deterministic validation evidence
forbiddenAuthorityTools: no unbounded database, network, shell, secret, or deployment authority
overlapNotes: Planner plans data; Implementation integrates; Security reviews consequences.
conflictNotes: Must not grant database execution or security approval.

proposedInternalSkills.title: Maintainable and Performant Incremental Implementation
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Choose maintainable local solutions and avoid avoidable runtime, bundle, and complexity costs during bounded implementation.
scope: reuse of existing helpers and conventions
proceduralSteps: identify the existing source of truth
prefer the smallest local change
check boundary, bundle, and data-flow consequences
validate and record only material residual risks
forbiddenAuthorityTools: no deployment, network benchmarking, package installation, or unrestricted mutation
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: Professional maintainability and performance reasoning above mechanical gates.
overlapNotes: Related reviewer skills are not injected into Implementation; this is an implementation procedure.
conflictNotes: Must not become Architecture or Code Review.

proposedInternalSkills.title: React and Next.js Integration Review
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Review semantic React/Next.js integration behavior after deterministic structural gates.
proceduralSteps: map the bounded change and canonical owner
trace data and event flow across components and handlers
check Server/Client and API boundary correctness
return evidence-backed findings with implementation ownership
forbiddenAuthorityTools: read-only; no source mutation, shell, browser, network, package installation, or approval authority
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: The missing review-oriented React/Next procedure without compiler duplication.
overlapNotes: Any external TypeScript review candidate is rejected as low incremental value.
conflictNotes: Must remain separate from Architecture, Security, and Test Review.

proposedInternalSkills.title: Authentication and Storage Security Review
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Review authentication, authorization, secrets, storage, and upload trust boundaries without offensive execution.
proceduralSteps: identify principals, assets, and trust boundaries
trace authentication and authorization decisions
inspect validation, storage/upload, secret, and error paths
return contextual findings with evidence and owner
forbiddenAuthorityTools: read-only; no shell, browser, network, exploit, package, database, or secret access
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: Factory-specific security coverage beyond RLS and broad OWASP categories.
overlapNotes: OWASP external methodology covers broad web risks; this covers Factory auth/storage surfaces.
conflictNotes: Offensive pentest candidates are explicitly excluded.

proposedInternalSkills.title: Behavioral Test Quality Review
proposedInternalSkills.purpose: Judge whether the smallest meaningful test strategy and evidence validate approved behavior and regression risk.
scope: Vitest, integration, and Playwright evidence quality
proceduralSteps: map approved behavior to evidence
check assertions and boundary/error paths
assess isolation, determinism, and test level
report semantic gaps with the smallest sufficient remedy
forbiddenAuthorityTools: read-only; no test execution, browser, shell, network, source mutation, or workflow authority
proposedInternalSkills.expectedContribution: A Factory-specific review strategy rather than an execution workflow or generic QA bundle.
overlapNotes: Shared traceability is supplied by requirements-evidence-traceability.
conflictNotes: Must not become Test Writer, QA executor, or Security Reviewer.
